# Fig Pro Audio

> Fig Pro Audio (Aldana Consulting LLC) makes audio plugins for Mac and Windows: FigAMP, a guitar amp simulator; FigGutEQ, an EQ made only for guitar; and FigSTRIP, a channel strip for mixing. All are one-time purchases with a free, fully featured 14-day trial, sold through Moonbase. Formats: Audio Unit (Mac), VST3 (Mac and Windows) and a standalone app. Requirements: macOS 11 or later (Apple Silicon or Intel), or Windows 10/11 64-bit. No subscription, no dongle.

## Products

- [FigAMP](https://figproaudio.com/): guitar amp plugin. Eight touch-sensitive classic amp voices (Singer, Brit 45, Chime 30, Black Panel, Hot 20, Liquid 100, Cali V, Steel 50), each with a Classic Tone button; input level control with VU meter; four studio console preamps (Brit 73, NY 312, Brit 4K, London A); compressor pedal; six matched cabinets plus your own impulse responses; tempo-synced delay; room reverb; Stereo Shift doubler; noise gate; Stereo/Mono switch; 16 factory presets and your own presets. Version 1.3.0. Price: $49 (MSRP $99). Buy: https://aldana-consulting-llc.moonbase.sh/buy/figamp. Trial: https://aldana-consulting-llc.moonbase.sh/download/figamp.
- [FigGutEQ](https://figproaudio.com/figguteq.html): the guitar-only EQ, built to sit next to FigAMP. Eight bands named for where a guitar lives (Low Cut, Bottom, Mud, Mids, Bite, Presence, Air, High Cut) with frequency and note readouts; Pick Attack (boost or cut only on the pick transient); Tuning Lock (marks open strings and moves the low end with the tuning, Standard E down to 8-string F#); real-time In/Out analyzer; zero latency with optional 2x/4x oversampling; STEREO/MONO switch with L/R meters; 18 presets, each in a PRE AMP and a POST AMP version. Version 1.0.0. Price: $29 launch price (MSRP $49). Buy: https://aldana-consulting-llc.moonbase.sh/buy/figguteq. Trial: https://aldana-consulting-llc.moonbase.sh/download/figguteq.
- [FigSTRIP](https://figproaudio.com/figstrip.html): channel strip plugin. Six sections in any order: Preamp (stepped or continuous gain, level-matched Drive, transformer), Filters (18 dB/oct high-pass, 12 dB/oct low-pass, can feed the sidechain), Dynamics (compressor with RMS/peak detection, auto release and auto make-up, plus gate/expander, external sidechain), Color EQ (broad stepped bands with a Fine mode), G EQ (four parametric bands) and Tape (drive, saturation, Warmth, output transformer, clip at -0.3 dBFS). Output with fader, pan, polarity, Mix and Auto Gain. Channel and Bus modes; Bus mode adds a glue compressor for mix buses and groups. 2x/4x oversampling or Zero Latency mode; mono, stereo and mono-to-stereo; undo/redo, A/B, 32 factory presets and your own presets in folders. Version 1.0.0. Price: $49 launch price (MSRP $99). Coming soon: not on sale yet; buy and trial links will be added at release.

## Licensing

Buy once, activate on your own computers by signing in with your Fig Pro Audio (Moonbase) account inside the plugin. The trial is fully featured for 14 days; afterwards the plugin passes audio through unprocessed until activated.
